pending.name: Glamsmossen peat extraction area and log-floating channel
pending.notes: Iteration 4: no authoritative discrete POI coordinate found for peat barns, peat works or channel signage. Official and older Upplandsleden/Florarna text corroborates peat extraction at Glamsmossen and the flottningskanal after Kakeläng. OSM way 705680867 is a strong mapped canal-line candidate aligned with the route, and OSM way 1437070426 corroborates the former Gubbo peat-factory industrial spur, but these are line/context features rather than importable point attractions. Keep as narrative/context only; suppress normal point import unless line-geometry context is supported.

pending.name: Kakeläng ruins
pending.notes: Keep pending, not suppressed. Current official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen text omits Kakeläng, but older guide text and BusinessBasecamp corroborate Kakeläng as route-context ruins. Rötter/Lantmäteriet-derived Svenska ortnamn classifies Kakeläng as a bebyggelselämning, and OSM maps two nearby ruined-building footprints; use their centroid as the best trail-relevant coordinate unless importing only current-official POIs.
